plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for AVTECH Room Alert 32E environmental monitors (ROOMALERT32E-MIB, PEN 20916). It reports internal temperature in Celsius, relative humidity, mains-or-battery power state, uptime, and interface traffic. Temperature and humidity default to four-digit output divided by 100, with a one-digit integer scale selected only when Fahrenheit cross-check disagrees on hundredths and agrees on units. Power is normalized so AC mains is healthy and battery is fault. Digital sensors and other Room Alert product trees are not collected in this pass.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the Room Alert 32E in degrees Celsius from internal-tempc (1.3.6.1.4.1.20916.1.8.1.1.2.0). Four-digit output is divided by 100; a one-digit integer scale is used only when the Fahrenheit leaf disagrees on hundredths and agrees within 1 C. Absent or invalid values are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Internal relative humidity of the Room Alert 32E in percent from internal-humidity (1.3.6.1.4.1.20916.1.8.1.2.1.0). The same scale as internal temperature is applied. Absent or invalid values are dropped.

metrics.name: env_power_state
metrics.description: Internal power source of the Room Alert 32E from internal-power (1.3.6.1.4.1.20916.1.8.1.3.1.0), normalized so AC mains (1) is healthy and battery or any other value is fault.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
